name: ocds
label: OCDS (Procurement)
description: Open Contracting Data Standard — used by 70+ governments

table_notes.ocds_buyer: Procuring entities (government agencies, ministries, local authorities) that initiate and manage contracting processes.
table_notes.ocds_supplier: Companies or individuals who bid on or are awarded public contracts; roles field captures OCDS party role codes.
table_notes.ocds_tender: Core contracting process record from first notice through close of bidding; one row per OCID (globally unique contracting process ID).
table_notes.ocds_award: Decision to award a contract to a specific supplier following evaluation of bids submitted against a tender.
table_notes.ocds_contract: Legally binding agreement signed between buyer and supplier following an award; tracks execution period and value.
table_notes.ocds_milestone: Key dates and deliverables within a contracting process (e.g. site visit, clarification deadline, delivery date).

ocds_buyer.name: id
ocds_buyer.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the buyer record

ocds_buyer.name: identifier
ocds_buyer.description: Buyer's official identifier string combining scheme and ID (e.g. GB-COH-12345678)

ocds_buyer.name: scheme
ocds_buyer.description: OCDS organization identifier scheme code (e.g. GB-COH, US-EIN). See org-id.guide.

ocds_buyer.name: name
ocds_buyer.description: Legal name of the buying organization as it appears in official records

ocds_buyer.name: address
ocds_buyer.description: Structured postal address: {streetAddress, locality, region, postalCode, countryName}

ocds_buyer.name: contact_point
ocds_buyer.description: Primary contact details: {name, email, telephone, faxNumber, url}

ocds_supplier.name: id
ocds_supplier.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the supplier record

ocds_supplier.name: identifier
ocds_supplier.description: Supplier's official identifier string combining scheme and ID (e.g. GB-COH-98765432)

ocds_supplier.name: scheme
ocds_supplier.description: OCDS organization identifier scheme code (e.g. GB-COH, US-EIN). See org-id.guide.

ocds_supplier.name: name
ocds_supplier.description: Legal or trading name of the supplier organization

ocds_supplier.name: address
ocds_supplier.description: Structured postal address: {streetAddress, locality, region, postalCode, countryName}

ocds_supplier.name: contact_point
ocds_supplier.description: Primary contact details: {name, email, telephone, faxNumber, url}

ocds_tender.name: id
ocds_tender.description: Internal UUID primary key for the tender row

ocds_tender.name: ocid
ocds_tender.description: OCDS globally unique contracting process identifier (prefix:identifier format, e.g. ocds-abc123-001)

ocds_tender.name: title
ocds_tender.description: Short human-readable title of the contracting process

ocds_tender.name: description
ocds_tender.description: Full narrative description of what is being procured

ocds_tender.name: buyer_id
ocds_tender.description: References ocds_buyer — the procuring entity initiating this contracting process

ocds_tender.name: procurement_method
ocds_tender.description: OCDS procurement method code: open, selective, limited, or direct

ocds_tender.name: procurement_method_details
ocds_tender.description: Free-text local description of the procurement method (national terminology)

ocds_tender.name: status
ocds_tender.description: OCDS tender status code: planning, planned, active, cancelled, unsuccessful, complete, withdrawn

ocds_tender.name: date_published
ocds_tender.description: Timestamp when this tender notice was first published

ocds_tender.name: tender_period_start
ocds_tender.description: Start of the period during which bids can be submitted

ocds_tender.name: tender_period_end
ocds_tender.description: Deadline for submission of bids (closing date)

ocds_tender.name: enquiry_period_end
ocds_tender.description: Deadline for suppliers to submit clarification questions

ocds_tender.name: value_amount
ocds_tender.description: Estimated total value of the contract to be awarded

ocds_tender.name: value_currency
ocds_tender.description: ISO 4217 currency code for value_amount (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

ocds_tender.name: main_procurement_category
ocds_tender.description: OCDS category code: goods, works, or services

ocds_tender.name: number_of_tenderers
ocds_tender.description: Count of valid bids received by the close of the tender period

ocds_award.name: id
ocds_award.description: Internal UUID primary key for the award record

ocds_award.name: tender_id
ocds_award.description: References ocds_tender — the contracting process this award belongs to

ocds_award.name: supplier_id
ocds_award.description: References ocds_supplier — the winning bidder receiving this award

ocds_award.name: title
ocds_award.description: Short title of this award (may differ from tender title for multi-lot procurements)

ocds_award.name: status
ocds_award.description: OCDS award status code: pending, active, cancelled, unsuccessful

ocds_award.name: date
ocds_award.description: Date and time the award decision was officially made

ocds_award.name: value_amount
ocds_award.description: Monetary value of this specific award

ocds_award.name: value_currency
ocds_award.description: ISO 4217 currency code for value_amount (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

ocds_award.name: items
ocds_award.description: Array of awarded line items: [{id, description, quantity, unit, classification}]

ocds_contract.name: id
ocds_contract.description: Internal UUID primary key for the contract record

ocds_contract.name: award_id
ocds_contract.description: References ocds_award — the award decision that gave rise to this contract

ocds_contract.name: title
ocds_contract.description: Official title of the signed contract document

ocds_contract.name: status
ocds_contract.description: OCDS contract status code: pending, active, cancelled, terminated

ocds_contract.name: period_start
ocds_contract.description: Date when contract obligations begin (commencement date)

ocds_contract.name: period_end
ocds_contract.description: Date when contract obligations expire (completion/expiry date)

ocds_contract.name: value_amount
ocds_contract.description: Total contracted value as stated in the signed agreement

ocds_contract.name: value_currency
ocds_contract.description: ISO 4217 currency code for value_amount (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

ocds_contract.name: date_signed
ocds_contract.description: Date the contract was formally executed by both parties

ocds_contract.name: description
ocds_contract.description: Narrative description of the contracted scope of work or supply

ocds_milestone.name: id
ocds_milestone.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the milestone record

ocds_milestone.name: tender_id
ocds_milestone.description: References ocds_tender — the contracting process this milestone belongs to

ocds_milestone.name: type
ocds_milestone.description: OCDS milestone type: preProcurement, approval, engagement, assessment, delivery, reporting

ocds_milestone.name: title
ocds_milestone.description: Short label for this milestone (e.g. 'Bid submission deadline', 'Final delivery')

ocds_milestone.name: due_date
ocds_milestone.description: Planned date by which this milestone should be reached

ocds_milestone.name: date_met
ocds_milestone.description: Actual date the milestone was achieved (NULL if not yet met)

ocds_milestone.name: status
ocds_milestone.description: OCDS milestone status code: scheduled, met, notMet, partiallyMet

short_description: Open Contracting Data Standard — used by 70+ governments
long_description: OCDS (Open Contracting Data Standard) defines how governments publish their procurement data — from tender announcement through contract award and implementation. The schema covers the complete contracting lifecycle: tenders with item descriptions, award decisions, contracts with values, and milestone tracking.
when_to_use: Use for government procurement platforms, anti-corruption monitoring tools, or any system working with public sector purchasing data. Mandatory for public procurement in Ukraine, Moldova, Colombia, and many other countries. Used by World Bank, UNDP, and 70+ national governments. Required for EU public procurement portal data feeds.
